lines: Drowning in nostalgia, we were still young and green
In the gaps where clouds remained, we just watched the sun
Half-hearted as we were, the voices spilling out of us
Somehow kept the things that mattered from getting through
I tried holding close a color with no shape
Days of hope and fear — I learned their taste as regret
I wanted to reach my hand toward a world I didn't know
I stuffed my bravado sky into my pocket
All of it, even the pain that wraps around kindness
I wanted to remember
Just wishing, wishing — even if I'm born again
Singing of an uncertain future, wanting to touch it
Trickling down, trickling down my cheek
The taste of those tears is a promise from someday
Just turning to ash, turning hazy
Off somewhere far, past this night, dyed in pale blue
All night long, the dreams, the longing spun through me
Still unfound, the moon cast its shadow
Sleepless till dawn, unable to let go of your hand
I pushed away the you I longed for
All of it, even the gaze I gave that day
Has gone blurry
Just aching, aching, unbearable — the sky's
Deep blue holds its color deep, and it's cold
Trickling down, trickling down — our shoulders pressed together, trembling
Holding that faint warmth
Toward a world not yet seen, flowers dance on the wind
Off somewhere far, past this night, dyed in pale blue
The mistakes I've made, even the regret that followed
Are things I couldn't trade for anything
Just wishing, wishing — even if I'm born again
Singing of an uncertain future, wanting to touch it
Trickling down, trickling down my cheek — the taste of those tears is a promise from someday
Just turning to ash, turning hazy
Off somewhere far, past this night, dyed in pale blue
